entries.what: Jun works the Tue-Sat cafe schedule after the extended hours began Oct 1, so Monday is his day off; he sleeps in, then preps filling at Tess's kitchen with OPM ballads playing.
entries.outcome: Fills two stockpots and sets aside a tray for Tess's taste test.

entries.what: Stops at the Ruel Road station to fill his hatchback and sees Anh's Flats Junction cart now advertises banh mi and egg rolls when he drops by to scope the competition.
entries.outcome: Buys a coffee-free egg roll to compare and grumbles about the rival cart.

entries.what: Evening he logs wrapper and shrimp receipts into Linh's sheet and notices costs are creeping up.
entries.outcome: Decides prices probably have to rise this weekend.

entries.what: Opens the cafe with Linh and runs a latte art lesson on tulip-rosettas before the rush.
entries.outcome: Linh pours her first clean tulip; Wes tips in quarters.

entries.what: Takes a double ristretto between rushes and texts Paolo about prep timing.
entries.outcome: Paolo replies with a vague maybe.

entries.what: After shift he picks up al pastor at Taquería Colima and eats in the car.
entries.outcome: Goes home full and tired.

entries.what: Works the 2-9 p.m. closing shift at Heron & Grind but forgets to restock oat milk because his mind is on the health permit packet; Beatrice leaves a note on the counter.
entries.outcome: Runs out of oat milk mid-evening; he apologizes and restocks, a one-off slip from distraction.

entries.what: Skips the council candidate forum at the community center, hearing about the Measure K debate from regulars at the cafe.
entries.outcome: Hears the warehouse growth argument secondhand.

entries.what: Closes the cafe, sweeps up and drives home late.
entries.outcome: Gets home near 10 and sleeps right away.

entries.what: Opening shift at the cafe; Beatrice's corgi Ledger naps in the back office.
entries.outcome: Smooth morning, oat milk fully stocked.

entries.what: At lunch he buys wrappers by the case in aisle 6 at Ruiz Family Market and winces at the total.
entries.outcome: Kenji rings him up; he saves the receipt for the sheet.

entries.what: Evening he tests a banana-jackfruit filling idea in Tess's kitchen.
entries.outcome: Tess says it needs less sugar.

entries.what: Works an opening shift, then drives to the Ruel Road commissary for the standing Friday 5-9 block.
entries.outcome: Fries and packs about 150 lumpia; scrubs the fryer area to dodge Joan's $40 fee.

entries.what: Paolo shows up late again after his closing line shift prep conflict and only helps pack.
entries.outcome: Jun jokes it off instead of saying anything.

entries.what: Late-night he sorts the week's receipts into the sheet.
entries.outcome: Totals show wrapper and shrimp costs up noticeably.

entries.what: Saturday at the Heron & Grind counter table he sells lumpia, and before opening drafts a price-increase sign with the assistant, worrying more about what Tess will say than customers.
entries.outcome: New price is $12 a half dozen and $22 a dozen; the sign is made friendlier.

entries.what: Wes buys his two lumpia in quarters and accepts the new price with a shrug.
entries.outcome: No customer complains.

entries.what: Afternoon he starts testing a turon dessert roll for the market at home.
entries.outcome: First batch is too sweet; he notes changes.

entries.what: Sunday morning pickup basketball at Delgado Park, then a stroll past the market lot.
entries.outcome: Sees Rick walking the lot and plans his waitlist follow-up.

entries.what: Tess samples the turon and gives her verdict over a family lunch.
entries.outcome: Says less sugar, but eats two.

entries.what: Evening he browses fourplex sublet listings off Vinca Avenue.
entries.outcome: Saves two listings to view.
